title: Nvidia Is Looking to Own Another Layer of the AI Ecosystem
excerpt: Nvidia just moved beyond selling processors and seized control of the invisible infrastructure that every AI cluster depends on, and the companies supplying...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • Nvidia's Spectrum-X Photonics platform is the first CPO Ethernet switch in mass production, delivering 5x lower network power and 64x better signal integrity.

  • Nvidia's networking revenue surged 199% to $15 billion as CoreWeave, Lambda, and Oracle adopt the new platform, cementing a rapidly widening competitive moat.

  • TSM and Lumentum supply the CPO buildout; Lumentum's revenue doubled to $1 billion with multi-hundred-million-dollar orders already locked in for 2027.

  • It sounds nuts, but SoFi1 is giving new Active Invest users up to $3,000 in stock for a limited time, and all it takes is a $50 deposit to get started.2 See for yourself (Sponsor)

Every AI story eventually runs into the same wall: power. Data centers can only pull so much electricity from the grid, and chips can only move data so fast before the network becomes the bottleneck instead of the processor. 

Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) posted $81.7 billion in revenue for its fiscal first quarter, up 85% year-over-year, with data center revenue alone hitting $75.2 billion. That kind of growth doesn't come from selling faster chips alone -- it comes from controlling the whole system those chips live in. Now, Nvidia just took its boldest step yet toward owning the wiring, not just the brains, of the AI factory.

The Networking Bottleneck Nvidia Just Solved

Nvidia just announced its Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics platform entered full mass production, becoming the first co-packaged optics (CPO) Ethernet switch built for 200G-per-lane volume shipping. 

Traditional AI data centers link GPUs using pluggable optical transceivers -- separate components that convert electrical signals to light and back again. At the scale of a million-GPU cluster, that's a liability: more lasers to fail, more power draw, more heat.

SoFi Active Invest is offering a limited-time promotion. Open an account, fund it with $50 or more, and you could receive up to $3,000 in complimentary stock for Active Invest accounts. See for yourself by clicking here now.

Nvidia's fix was to solder the optics directly onto the switch chip. The results are 4 times fewer lasers, 5x lower network power consumption, 10x better resiliency at scale, and a 64x improvement in signal integrity. Optical loss dropped from roughly 22 decibels to about 4. Translation for shareholders: fewer parts breaking down, lower electricity bills for customers, and a network that keeps pace as clusters scale into the millions of GPUs.

CoreWeave (NASDAQ:CRWV), Lambda, and Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) are the first customers, with production having ramped from May through July before reaching full volume. That's not a science project -- that's revenue.

每个人工智能故事最终都会遇到同一堵墙：权力。 数据中心只能从电网获取有限的电力，芯片传输数据的速度也只能如此快，否则网络（而不是处理器）将成为瓶颈。

英伟达（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）公布第一财季营收为 817 亿美元，同比增长 85%，其中仅数据中心营收就达到 752 亿美元。 这种增长不仅仅来自于销售更快的芯片，而是来自对这些芯片所在的整个系统的控制。 现在，英伟达刚刚迈出了迄今为止最大胆的一步，试图拥有人工智能工厂的线路，而不仅仅是大脑。

Nvidia 刚刚解决的网络瓶颈

Nvidia 刚刚宣布其 Spectrum-X 以太网光子平台进入全面量产，成为首款专为每通道 200G 批量出货而打造的共封装光学 (CPO) 以太网交换机。

传统的人工智能数据中心使用可插拔光收发器连接 GPU，这是一种将电信号转换为光信号并再次转换回来的独立组件。 对于百万 GPU 集群的规模来说，这是一种负担：更多的激光器会发生故障、功耗更大、热量更多。

SoFi Active Invest 正在提供限时促销活动。 开设一个账户，注入 50 美元或更多资金，您就可以为 Active Invest 账户获得高达 3,000 美元的免费股票。 立即点击此处亲自查看。

英伟达的解决方案是将光学器件直接焊接到开关芯片上。 结果是激光器数量减少了 4 倍，网络功耗降低了 5 倍，规模弹性提高了 10 倍，信号完整性提高了 64 倍。 光损耗从大约 22 分贝下降到大约 4 分贝。 对股东来说：更少的故障部件、更低的客户电费以及随着集群扩展到数百万个 GPU 而保持同步的网络。

CoreWeave（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）、Lambda 和 Oracle（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ORCL）是首批客户，其产量从 5 月到 7 月一直在增加，然后才达到满量。 这不是一个科学项目——而是收入。
